'''2000 Decipher World Championship Arthur Rhodes Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Arthur Rhodes]] played at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] (Day 1).<ref name="tr">[[Alex Tennet DecipherCon 2000: Juz, Beer and Cards (tournament report)]]</ref>
